findings.claim: The first decision's log line in every new repository says it was added `with kmctl new decision`, but kmctl init wrote it, so the log misstates the actor.

When init writes the first decision into a kept bundle it appends to the kept .okf/log.md and .okf/decisions/index.md (and .okf/index.md when the section is new), yet prints `kept .okf/log.md (already there)` and lists neither file under `updated` in --json, so the output says a changed file was left alone.
The broken-marker warning always says the file has kmctl:start without a kmctl:end after it, which is wrong for a file with only an end marker or with two start markers.
